Package hadur2.core.model

Class BattleFacts

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.model.BattleFacts
public final class BattleFacts extends Object
What the engine says about the battle before its first tick (ROLE-1): the field, the robots against us and the teammates beside us. The adapter reads them in run() and the core fixes its charter from them. A null or empty roster means no team. From A4 the adapter is a TeamRobot and passes the roster, its own name, its starting energy and the sentry border too.
